source: SOLIT2 Engineering Guidance Annex 2 section 6.2 (Class A without cover)

measured_notes.target_ignited: Annex 7 section 7.2.1's pass condition, inferred rather than read off a measurement. Annex 2 section 6.2 does not state a per-test target outcome. The basis is: section 5.2.6 requires a fire target in every Class A test and Annex 7 Figure 12 captions one as an "Example of undamaged target after a fire test"; section 7.2.1 makes non-ignition the pass condition, "Prevention of fire spread is essential in every case"; and Annex 2 section 6.2 reports this test as a successful suppressed test -- the same, with "The radiation was blocked by the water mist", and its Figure 16 shows the "Target object after a fire test with a SOLIT truck fire load". Treat as an inference, not a published datum.
